title: Semantic configuration comparison and visual diff
summary: Implemented interpreted design comparison with canvas overlays and precise report highlighting.

dates.note: First inspected milestone: 2025-10-13. See facts for earlier/later feature stages; this is neither proof of first-ever work nor a formal role/leadership start or shipped release date.

facts.text: Created logical-canvas diff tooling for newer NoC designs.
Built configuration comparison across instances, interfaces, connections, attributes, routes and source YAML, using two isolated Configuration Engine sessions.
Added canvas overlays and HTML reports with precise changed-text highlighting.
Compared two isolated engine snapshots across hardware entities, routes and parameters alongside recursive raw YAML differences, linking changes to logical-canvas overlays.
Implemented escaped, line-aligned HTML configuration reports with changed-span highlighting to expose precise differences in nested design data.

notes: 2026-10-27 local Git/source research supplements prior evidence. Authorship supports attributable implementation; shared components and later colleague changes retain separate ownership. No employer tests were rerun.
